description: Erection of single storey part rear extension (following demolition of existing addition) and formation of associated patio area at ground floor level; installation of balustrading surround to first floor flat roof for maintenance purposes and installation of walk-on glazing to front lightwell.
decision_conditions:
FLAT ROOF NOT USED AS AMENITY SPACE (COMPLIANCE): Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and reenacting that Order with or without modification), the use of the flat roofed extension hereby approved (as shown on approved drawing WA 25-011 109-1 PL) shall be as set out in the application and no development (including the formation of any door) providing access to the roof shall be carried out, nor shall the roof area be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area in perpetuity.

REASON: To prevent the undue overlooking of neighbouring habitable room windows and neighbouring gardens, and protect neighbouring amenity in accordance with Policy PLAN1 of Islington’s Strategic and Development Management Policies (2023).
